text:
Mike Liao: us-east-prod reporting sustained p99 SLO misses (~12:20–12:40 UTC). Not a single huge batch; instead we're seeing continuous small batches clogging the scheduler and driving GPU runqueue. Can someone pull admission traces?
Sandra K: on it — grabbing dashboards. any recent config changes to packer/admission?
Mike Liao: rolled out an admission tweak yesterday to reduce eviction churn; also lowered pack_window on some hosts. Suspect fragmentation + a bursty client. metrics snapshot: 
```
region: us-east-1
p50: 48ms p95: 122ms p99: 820ms
avg_queued_items_per_gpu: 230
small_batch_frac(<8 tokens): 68%
fill_rate: 0.14
```
Jordan: :eyes: small_batch_frac is massive. Which client(s) are responsible?
Mike Liao: top prefixes show a new partner "client-fingerprint" making tons of tiny prompts and hitting KV prefill frequently.
Anya: prefix caching + prefill CPU work can increase service time for tiny requests; if packer doesn't coalesce them, admission sees a steady trickle that prevents big efficient batches.
ops-bot: Deploy "admission/pack-window" to prod completed by ci-cd at 12:05 UTC
Jae: could try short-term mitigation: per-client rate limit or coalescing window for that fingerprint. Also consider increasing pack_window slightly to let tiny reqs merge.
Sandra K: spun up a temporary throttle at the edge for that client and enabled coalescing featureflag on 10% of the hosts in the region.
Mike Liao: after throttle, avg_queued_items_per_gpu dropped 230 -> 90 and p99 improved 820ms -> 420ms within 8m.
Jordan: nice. Need an actionable follow-up: audit packer heuristics for tiny payloads, add admission token smoothing, and add alerts for small_batch_frac rising.
Anya: I'll write a short runbook with mitigation steps (edge throttle, per-client coalesce, revert pack-window). Adding alert thresholds on small_batch_frac and avg_queued_items_per_gpu.
Mike Liao: saving traces/logs to /infra/snapshots/2150004321 and attaching to incident ticket. tagging @eng-sre for a postmortem and cost impact analysis. :thumbsup:
Sandra K: quick cost note — sustained lower throughput bumped GPU hours by ~8% in the 2h window. We'll include cost delta in the ticket.
Mike Liao: thanks team. keeping this thread for updates; removing throttle only after packer + admission changes validated.
Jordan: still seeing occasional blips but SLOs in-range now. monitoring for 1hr.
Anya: follow-ups logged in INFRA-3247 (coalesce heuristics, per-client RL, pack_window tuning, alerting).
Jae: will schedule a 30m sync with partner X to discuss client behavior and recommended client-side batching.
